- Annotators are asked to verify if the head entity (subject) and tail entity (object) are linked correctly. For each entity, we provide its Wikipedia title and link to its Wikidata page as additional context. After that, the annotators are asked to verify if the triple relation is correctly inferred from the sentence. Here, we provide the relation descriptions and example use cases of each relation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Information Extraction (triple generation) rather than traditional NLG. While it uses generative models (BART/mBART), the generated outputs are structured triples rather than natural language. The human evaluation was conducted for dataset annotation, not for evaluating model outputs. The paper extensively evaluates model performance using automatic metrics.
